evidence.claim: The company reports its Embocaps product line features Standard Gelatin utilizing a blend of Type B bovine and Type A porcine gelatines, alongside specialized variations such as Pharmaceutical-Grade Fish Gelatine and its VG series hypromellose (HPMC) plant-based alternatives.

A product patent verification shows that a researcher named Yang at Suheung Capsule Co., Ltd. developed and patented alternative cellulose-based capsule formulations using a mixed solution of pectin and glycerin.

The company reports in its official EMBOCAPS Specification Datasheet precise mechanical tolerances for its hard gelatin and HPMC capsule sizes (000 to 5), maintaining a length tolerance of ±0.4–0.5 mm, outside diameter tolerance of ±0.06 mm, total volume tolerance of ±3%, and weight tolerance of ±10–11%.

The company reports that its patented EMBO CAPS design utilizes a proprietary four-dimple embossed configuration on the main locking groove, a computer-engineered dome radius, and custom air venting to optimize mechanical hoop strength, prevent premature separation during high-speed closing, and minimize telescoping defects on EMBOCAPS Capsule Design.

The company reports the development of the EMBO CAPS® AP product line, which features an acid-resistant HPMC delayed-release design that prevents premature capsule disintegration in gastric environments to protect acid-sensitive ingredients such as probiotics and enzymes.

The company reports the commercialization of its next-generation EMBOCAPS® AP60 capsule, which provides a minimum of one hour of guaranteed acid protection in gastric fluids before delaying release until reaching the intestinal tract.

Suheung Co., Ltd. announced the expansion of its Long Thanh plant in Vietnam by adding 10 capsule machines to increase the facility's total count to 52 production lines within three years, elevating its total global capacity to a projected 5.1 billion capsules annually as reported by KED Global.

The company reports in its 2023 Sustainability Report that it completed the expansion of hard capsule production facilities at its Suheung Vietnam second plant, strengthening its regional production capacity and ability to respond to North American market demand.

Suheung Co., Ltd. successfully submitted and completed China DMF filings with the National Medical Products Administration for its EMBOCAPS® Empty Hard HPMC Capsules (assigned pre-assigned DMF Number F20190000399) and Empty Hard Gelatin Capsules (F20190000400) in 2019, as outlined in official regulatory announcements published on Embocaps.

The World Health Organization (WHO) published a Public Inspection Report confirming that Suheung Co., Ltd.'s manufacturing facility was audited between April 8 and April 12, 2019, verifying compliance with good manufacturing practices for contract production of bulk capsules, according to the WHO Prequalification Team Inspection Report.
